page.layout: Right printed page: running head at top right with page number "735" beside it; below it, one block of text in italic lines at the top right. Left of the scan, the edge of a neighbouring page with blurred text in a left margin column, which is show-through and not transcribed.; One column of italic and roman text, right of the binding shadow; a rule across the middle; a short signed note at the foot right. No printed margin notes beyond the signature mark.

main_text.p: irem autem quantum c alind liceret, aliquot nuper à me habitas, putaui. Inter quas b argumento gratam commendet eam discisaugustior, & in qua literarum Mæcenas.
viro Cornelio Nicolai, is Præfecto, quod Rotenissimo.
per diximus, bona fi-mitto, Vir Clarissime.

pro amore in te meo, ijs inter nos sic conuenire non andeo: quod quem suscepit com-judicio, inter sapien-on inepto, non fastidiosophorum morbus olim latores antiquissimus, sed urbano, elegantique ac to ac Xenophon depin-butat, ludit: cum de-, latum à se hilarem-t: soluit denique quos rtatem asserit. Adde nnes formas, omnium.

page.notes: The visible part of the page is only the upper right portion; the text is cut off after the second line and the lines are partly hidden by the page edge. Line beginnings are missing where the scan is blank or cropped. The left strip shows the outer edge of the neighbouring page, with blurred and mirrored text, which is not transcribed. Readings of the first line are uncertain: "nunc offerre tibi possem" is read from the italic type with the first letters partly cut off by the page edge. Lines are cut at the left by the binding shadow; word beginnings are missing in several lines and are left as they appear. The rule across the middle separates the dedicatory address from the letter.
